chunks: And when they passed by them, they winked at one another;

key_terms.يَتَغَامَزُونَ: They winked at one another; exchanged subtle signals

ai.seo_question: What did the hypocrites do when they passed by the believers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological duality of the Munafiqun, who use subtle gestures (taghamuz) to coordinate their mockery while preserving a public facade of unity. This behavior reflects their internal dissonance between outward conformity and inward disbelief, a key theme in understanding their spiritual state in the Quranic narrative.
